(()=>{const r=window.__ll.run; window.__compOrders=(n)=>{let done=0; for(let k=0;k<n;k++){let w=0; while(r.phase==='playing'&&!r.currentOrder&&w++<700) r.step({pouring:false}); if(r.phase!=='playing'||!r.currentOrder) break; const o=r.currentOrder; let g=0; while(g++<500&&r.currentOrder){ if(r.pour.state==='pouring'&&r.pour.level>=o.line-0.005) break; r.step({pouring:true}); } r.step({pouring:false}); for(let i=0;i<10;i++) r.step({pouring:false}); done++;} return done;}; window.__compOrders(1);})()

steps.eval: (()=>{const r=window.__ll.run; let guard=0; while(r.phase!=='dead'&&r.phase!=='won'&&guard++<60000){ if(r.phase==='shop'){r.nextDay();continue;} if(r.currentOrder){ const o=r.currentOrder; for(let k=0;k<Math.ceil(o.patienceMax/0.0166667)+2&&r.currentOrder;k++) r.step({}); } else { r.step({}); } } return r.phase;})()

(()=>{const r=window.__ll.run; if(!r.currentOrder) return 0; const o=r.currentOrder; let g=0; while(g++<500&&r.currentOrder){ if(r.pour.state==='pouring'&&r.pour.level>=o.line-0.005) break; r.step({pouring:true}); } r.step({pouring:false}); for(let i=0;i<10;i++) r.step({pouring:false}); return r.dayOrdersFilled;})()
